headline: PENTAGON BACKS ENERGY FUELS WITH $725M RARE EARTH LOAN — SHARES SURGE 16% AS US BETS WHITE MESA MILL CAN CHALLENGE CHINA
source_name: Mining.com / Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE: UUUU, TSX: EFR)
snippet: Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE: UUUU) announced June 18, 2026 that the U.S. Department of Defense Office of Strategic Capital committed a conditional $725 million senior secured loan with a 20-year tenor to expand critical minerals processing at the company's White Mesa Mill in Utah — the only conventional uranium mill operating in the US — and to fund construction of a new rare earth metals and alloys facility in the United States. The commitment follows Energy Fuels completing its first commercial run of NdPr oxide in its Phase 1 rare earth element circuit, with current capacity sufficient to power approximately 1 million EVs per year and plans to scale to 6 million EV equivalents by 2027. Shares surged 16% on the news. For junior rare earth investors, the OSC commitment represents the most concrete US government financial backing yet for a domestic REE processing platform independent of China's refining infrastructure, validating the White Mesa integrated uranium-rare earth business model.

headline: WARSH SKIPPED HIS OWN FOMC DOT — GOLD $4,244 AND SILVER $67 SLIP AS HAWKS HOLD FLOOR WITHOUT THE CHAIR'S THUMBPRINT
snippet: Spot gold fell to $4,244.60 and silver slid to $66.995 in US morning trading Thursday June 18 as markets continued digesting Wednesday's hawkish Federal Reserve hold — with the key new detail that Chair Kevin Warsh declined to submit his own dot to the June 2026 summary of economic projections, meaning the nine officials projecting at least one 2026 rate hike came entirely from non-chair FOMC members. Combined with the US-Iran interim peace accord signed in Switzerland driving oil to $80.53 on Hormuz reopening expectations, the session reflects a macro crossfire: lower oil moderates the inflation case for a hike, yet Warsh's non-submission leaves the chair's personal policy stance deliberately ambiguous — a detail traders are reading as less explicitly hawkish than the dot chart surface suggests, providing the structural support that prevented gold from breaking below $4,200 despite the Wednesday selloff.

headline: VIZSLA COPPER FIRES TWO RIGS AT PALMER ALASKA VMS — $19.2M DRILL PROGRAM TARGETS HIGH-GRADE COPPER IN US CRITICAL MINERALS CORRIDOR
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Vizsla Copper Corp. (TSXV: VCU)
snippet: Vizsla Copper Corp. (TSXV: VCU) announced June 18, 2026 that diamond drilling has commenced at its Palmer Volcanogenic Massive Sulphide Project in Southeast Alaska, with two drill rigs on site and a $19.2 million fully funded budget for 10,000 metres of drilling — the first phase of a multi-year strategy to expand the project's critical minerals resource base across more than 15 km of prospective VMS stratigraphy. Initial drilling targets the Palmer Deposit's South Wall Zone, where previous work identified the highest copper grades intersected on the property within a high-grade copper-rich core in Zone 1. The Palmer district hosts polymetallic VMS mineralisation including copper, zinc, silver, gold, and cobalt — a critical minerals suite that aligns with US domestic supply-security priorities at COMEX copper near $6.50/lb — and two simultaneous rigs accelerate the program timeline to maximise the probability of a discovery announcement before year-end.

headline: CASSIAR GOLD DRILLS INTO 2.3 MOZ BC DEPOSIT — 10,000m PHASE 1 TESTS EXTENSIONS BELOW 150m SHALLOW TAURUS RESOURCE
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Cassiar Gold Corp. (TSXV: GLDC)
snippet: Cassiar Gold Corp. (TSXV: GLDC) announced June 18, 2026 the opening of its exploration camp and launch of its fully funded 2026 field season with Phase 1 diamond drilling commencing at the Taurus Deposit in the Cassiar North project area in northern British Columbia. The 10,000-metre program targets resource expansion, step-outs beyond the current block model, and infill gaps at a deposit hosting 410,000 oz Indicated at 1.43 g/t Au and 1.93 million oz Inferred at 0.95 g/t Au — with 91% of ounces within 150 metres of surface, making Taurus a straightforward bulk-tonnage open-pit target at gold's current floor near $4,244/oz. Previous drilling at the adjacent Newcoast area confirmed broad intervals of gold mineralisation and high-grade quartz veining with visible gold extending a 4-kilometre prospective corridor, giving the 2026 program two discovery vectors simultaneously.

headline: GOLDGROUP FIRES 24,000m DRILL AT FULLY PERMITTED 1.2 MOZ SONORA GOLD MINE — PRODUCTION RESTART TARGETED LATE 2026
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Goldgroup Mining Inc. (TSXV: GGA, OTCQX: GGAZF)
snippet: Goldgroup Mining Inc. (TSXV: GGA) announced June 18, 2026 the commencement of a 24,000-metre diamond core drilling program at its fully permitted San Francisco Gold Project in Sonora, Mexico — an $8 million, in-house-funded program targeting infill drilling to tighten historic drill spacing, optimize the mine plan, and advance the project toward a restart of gold production in late 2026 or early 2027. San Francisco hosts 1.226 million oz M&I gold with an additional 178,000 oz Inferred, and Goldgroup acquired 100% of the project earlier in 2026. The program is expected to complete in Q3 2026, positioning the board for a production-restart decision before year-end. At gold near $4,244/oz, a fully permitted 1.2 Moz Sonora gold mine with in-house financing and a defined restart path represents one of the cleaner near-term production re-entry stories on the TSXV.

headline: K2 GOLD MAPS 210m DISSEMINATED ENVELOPE AT NEVADA SI2 — EPITHERMAL VEINS CUT 18m AT 0.21 g/t AU WITH 5 g/t SILVER
source_name: Junior Mining Network / K2 Gold Corp. (TSXV: KTO)
snippet: K2 Gold Corp. (TSXV: KTO) released June 18, 2026 assay results from its 2026 reverse circulation drilling program at the Si2 Gold Project in Esmeralda County, Nevada — with one hole intersecting 210.31 metres of rhyolite-hosted disseminated gold-silver mineralisation at 0.123 g/t Au, within which a discrete epithermal quartz vein zone returned 18.28 metres at 0.213 g/t Au including 4.57 metres at 0.493 g/t Au with 5.01 g/t Ag. The 210-metre envelope defines a bulk tonnage target geometry typical of Nevada heap-leach gold systems, while the high-grade vein core provides the structural vector for a higher-grade discovery target within the broader system. Esmeralda County is one of Nevada's most productive gold-silver jurisdictions, and the identification of both a bulk disseminated envelope and a structurally controlled vein system within the same RC hole sets up a drill program that can test both deposit styles simultaneously.

headline: SOUTHERN SILVER PURO CORAZON INFILL DRILL MOBILISED — CERRO LAS MINITAS AG-PB-ZN EXPANSION BEGINS IN DURANGO
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Southern Silver Exploration Corp. (TSXV: SSV)
snippet: Southern Silver Exploration Corp. (TSXV: SSV) announced June 18, 2026 that drill crews have mobilised for infill drilling on the Puro Corazon target at its Cerro Las Minitas Project in Durango, Mexico, following 2025-2026 drilling that delineated multiple high-grade polymetallic silver-lead-zinc intercepts. The infill campaign is designed to convert Puro Corazon's newly delineated mineralised zones from drill-defined to resource-classified, advancing the project toward an updated mineral resource estimate. At silver near $67/oz with the Silver Institute projecting a sixth consecutive annual supply deficit of 46.3 million ounces, a Durango silver-lead-zinc resource expansion campaign at a project with confirmed high-grade drill results represents a meaningful near-term catalyst for a junior silver explorer seeking to reach resource classification ahead of any sector re-rating.

headline: GREENLAND BLOCKS ETM'S RARE EARTH LICENCE — COMPANY PIVOTS TO SPAIN'S GALICIA FOR NEXT PRODUCTION PLATFORM
snippet: Energy Transition Minerals (ASX: ETM) is pursuing a multi-mine expansion strategy in Spain's Galicia province after Greenland's government signalled its intention to recommend against renewing the company's Kvanefjeld exploration licence — citing legislative barriers under Greenland's Uranium Act that prevent granting an exploitation licence. ETM's subsidiary filed its formal consultation objection on June 15, 2026 and expects to restart mining at the Penouta tin-tantalum project in Galicia in 18-24 months, while pursuing additional Spanish mine acquisitions in a province planning to revive up to 52 idled mines. The strategic pivot comes as ETM simultaneously announced on June 12 the discovery of 10 new REE zones at Kvanefjeld — including a new 1.8-kilometre mineralised trend with high-grade dysprosium and terbium at sub-100ppm uranium concentrations — making the Greenland licence fight's outcome even more consequential for heavy rare earth supply chains outside China.

headline: GOLDSILVER: SILVER CORRECTION WAS THE SETUP — GSR AT 61.7 AND SIX-YEAR DEFICIT STREAK MAKE CURRENT LEVELS A STRUCTURAL ENTRY
snippet: GoldSilver.com's June 2026 silver outlook argues that the metal's pullback from its January 29 all-time high of $121.62 to current levels near $67-70 is not a structural reversal but the setup for the next bull leg: the gold-silver ratio at 61.7 remains historically compressed relative to the bull's starting level, the Silver Institute projects a sixth consecutive annual supply deficit of 46.3 million ounces, and six years of cumulative drawdown from above-ground stockpiles creates the physical inventory stress that has historically surfaced in LBMA delivery delays and COMEX tightness before major price accelerations. The article identifies the US-Iran ceasefire oil drop as a genuine macro tailwind — lower energy inflation reduces Fed urgency — sets a year-end target range of $90-$106, and flags the single bear case variable: ceasefire breakdown and oil re-spiking above $100, which would cause silver to retest the $60-$63 support band. For silver mining investors sitting on a 40-45% correction from the ATH, the GSR and deficit framework provides a data-backed case for holding positions through the current volatility.
